# Unova

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Unova has 43 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Black 2 and White 2 (both versions).

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges. 

## The ladder at a glance

| # | Trainer | Where | Type | Levels | Earns |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cheren | Aspertia | Normal | 11-13 | Basic Badge |
| 2 | Roxie | Virbank | Poison | 16-18 | Toxic Badge |

#### Gym 1: Cheren (Aspertia) -- the Basic Badge
Normal specialist. 2 Pokemon, best level 13: your team fights at level 13 at most, and on hard you bring 2 at most. Prize money: $650 on easy, $1,300 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Patrat | Normal | 11 | Tackle, Bite, Leer |
| Lillipup | Normal | 13 | Tackle, Bite, Work Up, Leer |

Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Unova by this point, raised to level 13 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 2).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).
